product_read: A new house espresso from a two-person roastery: the assets have to show the real kraft bag in an honest kitchen-morning light and make it feel made by hand, not marketed.

stills.name: Product photo, cleaned up
stills.use: shop product page, square gallery image
stills.prompt: Edit this product photo: keep the coffee bag exactly as it is, same position, same packaging, label text and copper hill logo untouched and fully legible. Replace the background with an off-white (#EFE6D8) seamless paper sweep, add soft natural window light from the left with a gentle directional shadow falling right, and place five or six roasted beans at the base. Matte surfaces only. Avoid: pure white or grey backdrop, glossy reflections, steam, splashes, flying beans, gradients.

stills.name: Tuesday morning counter
stills.use: Instagram feed post and product page gallery, portrait
stills.prompt: The coffee bag from the reference image on a worn oak kitchen counter at 8am, next to a ceramic espresso cup with a speckled thumbprint glaze and a folded linen towel. Keep the packaging, label text and copper hill logo exactly as in the reference image. Low side light from a kitchen window on the right, warm and soft, long gentle shadows. A copper milk jug at the edge of frame as the single warm accent. Palette of kraft brown, roast brown and off-white. Shallow depth of field, calm composition with space above the bag. Avoid: hands, people, latte art, steam effects, neon, glossy surfaces.

stills.name: Wide banner with headline room
stills.use: homepage hero banner and the weekly email header
stills.prompt: Wide banner photograph. The coffee bag from the reference image sits on the right third of a long oak shelf against a warm off-white (#EFE6D8) plaster wall, with the left two thirds left as clean, softly lit empty wall for a headline. Keep the packaging, label text and copper hill logo exactly as in the reference image. Low golden side light from the right casting a soft copper-tinted glow across the wall. One small ceramic cup beside the bag, nothing else. Avoid: clutter, gradients, pure white, sparkles, beans in the air, any text in the image.

motion.prompt: Very slow push-in toward the bag, about ten percent over five seconds, while the window light drifts slightly warmer across the scene. The bag and its label stay perfectly still and sharp; only the camera and the light move.
motion.negative_prompt: warping label, morphing logo, changing text, bag moving or rotating, hands, people, steam, splashes, flying beans, sparkles, fast camera moves
